objective: Release 0.3.2: browser-use for the headless screen form, fff following links by default, updated dependencies, the atomics test fix.
requirements: Maintainer (verbatim, 2026-11-10): "use browser use, not playwright https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use". The screen capability's headless form (cloud or CI sessions) uses browser-use instead of the Playwright MCP server (@playwright/mcp); the normal form keeps opencode browse with a paired real browser plus pi-computer-use.

Maintainer (verbatim, 2026-11-10): "change the fff search default as well". Read as the one fff default reported to the maintainer: setup no longer writes followSymlinks: false to pi-fff.json, so fff follows directory links as its own default does (revisitable: a link inside a repository to a folder such as ~/.ssh becomes searchable).

Maintainer (verbatim, 2026-11-10): "update deps as well". Dependencies move through mise run deps:update (GitHub Actions, vendored ripgrep and fd, mise tools, Pi package pins, package.json ranges, bun.lock), and the release passes its gates on the new versions.

Maintainer (verbatim, 2026-11-10): "bump to 0.3.2". Release 0.3.2: release/0.3.2/integration cut from main, the first PR carries mise run bump:patch as its own commit, every later branch is cut after it, and only the integration branch opens the PR into main.
Carried from 0.3.1: the bash-atomics test fix (keep the vm realm of the native waitAsync alive; reviewed) ships in 0.3.2.

Testing rules carried: never run pi; never make live Kimi, Codex or OpenAI requests; unit tests and fixtures only. Standing authority: squash-merge reviewed green PRs, including the release PR into main; continue until mergeable or blocked.
Every third-party package or binary sits at an exact pin moved only through mise run deps:update; each capability is its own module that can be turned off.
